question: Under the Regulating Act of 1773, the Supreme Court was established by British Emperor in which of the following cities in British India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Supreme Court was established in **Calcutta** under the Regulating Act of 1773.
 
• This act was enacted by the British Parliament to address the deficiencies in the administration of the British East India Company.
 
• The Supreme Court in Calcutta was the highest judicial authority in British India at that time.
 
• It marked the beginning of a structured judicial system in India, providing a foundation for subsequent legal and judicial developments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Regulating Act of 1773 was a significant step towards the centralization of British administration in India.
 
• It also led to the appointment of the Governor-General of Bengal, who had supervisory authority over the other British presidencies in India.
 
• The Act was one of the earliest attempts by the British government to regulate the affairs of the East India Company and its territories in India.
 
• The establishment of the Supreme Court aimed at ensuring justice and addressing the grievances of the local population as well as the British subjects in India.
